transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... I keep hearing people talking about me. It happens a lot at work. I'll hear them through the conference room walls, or even from my cell phone when it's completely turned off. 

It's usually the board members or my staff, and they're... they're saying I'm ruining the company. The thing is, it sounds so incredibly clear. It's so real that I actually answer them back out loud, right there, before I even realize that no one else around me heard a thing.
Have you ever felt that people are plotting against you, or that you're receiving special messages that others don't understand?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't think anyone is secretly plotting against me, and I'm definitely not getting any special or hidden messages. 

It's really just... exactly what I said. I just hear them talking about my performance and how I'm running the company into the ground. There's no secret meaning or conspiracy to it, I just literally hear their voices saying these things.
Do you have any beliefs or thoughts about why you're hearing these voices, or what might be causing them?

I don't really know. I've tried to figure it out, but... I just don't have an explanation for it. I'm not taking any new medications, I haven't hit my head, nothing like that. It just started happening. I mean, I know it's not normal to hear things that aren't there, especially coming from a phone that's turned off, but... I honestly have no idea why it's happening to me.
Have you ever had any strong beliefs or suspicions that others are not involved in or aware of, such as thinking certain people are working against you, even if you can't prove it?

No, not at all. I think I mentioned this just a minute ago, but... I really don't have any suspicions like that. I don't think anyone is secretly working against me or trying to sabotage me behind my back. 

I mean, sure, there's always normal office politics when you run a company, but I don't have any deep beliefs about a hidden plot or anything. It's... it's really just the voices themselves. I just hear them saying those things out loud, but I don't believe there's an actual conspiracy going on.
Have you ever had any unusual beliefs or ideas that you hold onto strongly, even when others don’t share them or think they don’t make sense?

No, I really don't. I feel like we're kind of covering the same ground here, but... the answer is still no. I don't have any strange ideas or beliefs that I'm clinging to. 

I mean, I know the fact that I'm hearing voices from a dead phone doesn't make sense to anyone else, and it doesn't make sense to me either. But I don't have any unusual theories about it or the world in general. I'm just telling you exactly what I'm experiencing, nothing more than that.
Have you experienced these voices or similar symptoms continuously for at least one month?

Yes, it's been longer than a month. The voices... whether they're coming from the walls or out of my phone... they've been happening for about the past three months now. So, yes, it's been continuous for at least that long.
Have you ever seen things that others don't see, like shadows, people, or objects that aren't actually there?

No, I haven't. I've never seen anything that isn't there. No shadows or... or people, nothing like that. Like I was saying before, it's really just the voices I'm hearing. My vision is perfectly fine, I don't see anything unusual at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to function at work or in your daily life because of these voices?

Yes, it's definitely affected my ability to function. I'm... I'm a chief executive, and I'm just no longer reliably able to run my division. I can't keep up with basic executive decisions anymore. It's gotten to the point where my senior staff have quietly stepped in and taken over the work I used to handle myself. 

And it's not just at work. At home, my husband has had to take on almost all the household responsibilities. I just... I either leave things completely unfinished, or I don't even start them at all. So, yes, the impact has been pretty significant.
Have you ever believed something to be true that others don’t, even when they’ve tried to show you that it’s not true?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had any unusual beliefs or anything like that. People haven't had to try and convince me that something isn't real... it's just the voices. I know what's real and what's not, I just... I hear things that other people don't. But as far as believing things that aren't true, no, I haven't experienced that.
Have you ever felt physical sensations or touches that others don’t seem to feel, like something crawling on your skin or being touched when no one is there?

No, I haven't... I haven't felt anything like that. There's no crawling on my skin or feeling like someone is touching me when they aren't. Physically, everything feels completely normal. It really is just the voices that I'm dealing with.
Have you ever experienced any other types of hallucinations, like smelling things that aren't there, tasting something unusual without a cause, or hearing internal thoughts spoken out loud?

No, I haven't experienced any of those either. I don't smell or taste anything strange, and... no, I don't hear my thoughts spoken out loud. Like I said, it really is just the voices. That's the only thing.
Have you noticed any changes in your emotions or motivation, like feeling emotionally flat or having trouble getting started on tasks?

Yes, I have noticed that. It's actually been a pretty drastic change. I used to be the person driving every idea at the company, always calling people after openings and keeping things moving. But now... I can just sit at my desk for hours, just staring at the agenda. I don't even try to get started. 

I barely speak to my staff anymore, and it's the same with my husband at home. I just feel almost nothing about the work I used to really love. The drive just isn't there.
Have you ever had a strong belief that something is true, even when others have shown you evidence that it isn't?

No, I don't think so. I haven't had anything like that. I know what I believe, and... well, I haven't had anyone trying to prove me wrong or show me evidence about things. So, no, I haven't experienced that.
Have you ever had a belief that turned out not to be true, but you were absolutely sure it was true at the time, even if no one else agreed with you?

No, honestly, I haven't. It's like I mentioned just a moment ago... I don't really have anything like that happen. I've never been in a situation where I was absolutely convinced of something that turned out to be completely false, or where everyone else was disagreeing with me about what was true. 

My issues are really just... the voices, and that total lack of drive I told you about. But no, no strange beliefs.
Have you ever had a belief that others were not aware of something that you felt was very real, even if you couldn’t explain it to others or they didn’t understand?

No, I haven't. It's... well, like I was trying to say before, I just don't have those kinds of thoughts or beliefs. I don't have secret knowledge or feel like I know things that other people don't. It's really just the voices I hear and the fact that I can't seem to care about my work or my life anymore. That's what's happening to me.
Have you experienced these voices or any other unusual symptoms for a period of six months or longer without a break?

Yes, it's been going on for a long time now. I'd say this has been building for about two years and four months. It started around the time the company expanded and they put me in charge of the new arts-and-commerce division. It hasn't stopped since then.

Have you ever had a false belief that you were certain was true, even though others told you it wasn't, such as believing you had a serious illness when there was no medical evidence, or believing you were being spied on without any proof?

No... I really haven't. I know you're asking about different examples now, like being spied on or having some hidden physical illness, but the answer is still no. 

I don't have any false beliefs like that. I'm completely grounded in reality when it comes to what's going on around me, and I don't think people are after me. It's just... well, just the things we already talked about.
